title: Taking a URL apart
hints: url.Parse(raw) returns a *url.URL with Scheme, Host, Path and RawQuery fields. Check the error, the scheme and that Host isn't empty.
u.Host can include a port ("example.com:8443"). u.Hostname() and u.Port() split it for you, and they handle IPv6 brackets.
When u.Port() is empty, use "443" for https and "80" for http. u.Query().Get("token") reads the token.
